name: What is the difference between routine home maintenance and restoration maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between routine home maintenance and restoration maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Restoration maintenance preserves structural materials, woodwork, and interior finishes after an initial repair or to prevent ongoing deterioration. Routine maintenance typically covers basic cosmetic upkeep like minor touch-up painting or regular cleaning. In contrast, restoration maintenance targets long-term preservation, such as re-sealing exterior log finishes, repairing failing drywall joints, replacing deteriorated trim, or addressing residual moisture damage after storms. It focuses on reviving aged or damaged elements to protect their integrity rather than just maintaining surface appearances. The choice depends on whether materials simply need cleaning or require active rehabilitation to prevent further structural degradation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration maintenance rehabilitates damaged or aging materials like logs, drywall, and woodwork, while routine maintenance handles basic surface upkeep and cleaning.
